Reference: - Planning Department Government Order No.1218 / Q.05 / Ka-1427,
Statistical Officer / Research on Establishment of Directorate of Finance and Statistics

Officers, Group- "B" (Gazetted) are officers appointed by nomination under the Government Order in respect of a cadre post and are required to produce a certificate of passing the examination prescribed by the Government in respect of computer handling within two years from the date of their appointment.

General Administration Department, No. Training 2000 / Q. 61/2001/39, D. 19/03/2003 and Government Decision Information Technology (GDIT) Department No: Matans-2012 / Pt. Officers who have passed the course in Computer / Information Technology subject mentioned in paragraph-1 of No. 277/39, dated 04/02/2012 are deemed to have passed the Computer Aptitude Test. The following officers appointed in the cadre of "Statistical Officer / Research Officer, Group-" B (Gazetted) "at the establishment of the Directorate of Finance and Statistics have completed the course indicated in their name. Hence, he is believed to have passed the Computer Aptitude Test prescribed by the government.
